defs.en: To a great extent or degree.
defs.ex: That dress is very you.

defs.en: Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true.
Used to firmly establish that nothing else surpasses in some respect.
defs.ex: He was the very best runner there.

ja: （形容詞・副詞を強調）とても、大変。

defs.en: True, real, actual.
defs.ex: the fierce hatred of a very woman

defs.en: The same; identical.
defs.ex: He proposed marriage in the same restaurant, at the very table where they first met.

defs.en: With limiting effect: mere.
defs.ex: The very idea of climbing the ladder brings me out in a sweat.

ja: 真実の、実の、現実の、本当の。

defs.en: Transient visual content or media, processed with technology, especially electronic.
defs.ex: Early TV used film to record video.

defs.en: A recording or medium of visual content, especially audiovisual content for playback; a motion picture, movie, film.
defs.ex: We edited a video montage of Robbie's first birthday.

defs.en: Television content or media.
videotape, VHS.

ja: テレビ、テレビ番組、映画、映像作品。
ビデオ、VTR、映像作品を磁気テープなどに録画する方式又は録画したもの。

defs.en: To record using a video camera, to videotape.
To record a television program.
To visually record (activity, or a motion picture) in general, with or without sound.
The act of seeing or looking at something.
defs.ex: He changed seats to get a complete view of the stage.

defs.en: The range of vision.
defs.ex: If there are any rabbits in this park, they keep carefully out of our view.

defs.en: Something to look at, such as scenery.
defs.ex: My flat has a view of a junkyard.

defs.en: An individual viewing of a web page or a video etc. by a user.
defs.ex: That video got a million views.

defs.en: A picture, drawn or painted; a sketch.
defs.ex: a fine view of Lake George

defs.en: To look at.
defs.ex: Reporters viewed a private screening of the upcoming film.

defs.en: To regard in a stated way.
defs.ex: I view it as a serious breach of trust.

defs.en: The quality that renders something desirable or valuable; worth.
defs.ex: There is tremendous value in a good education.

defs.en: The degree of importance given to something.
defs.ex: The value of my children's happiness is second only to that of my wife.

defs.en: That which is valued or highly esteemed, such as one's morals, morality, or belief system.
defs.ex: He does not share his parents' values.

defs.en: The amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else.
defs.ex: The value of the stolen painting is estimated to be around four million pounds.

defs.en: The relative duration of a musical note.
defs.ex: The value of a crotchet is twice that of a quaver.

ja: 価値観。重視されるべき考え。

defs.en: To determine or estimate the value of; to judge the worth of.
defs.ex: I will have the family jewels valued by a professional.

defs.en: To regard highly; think much of; place importance upon.
defs.ex: Gold was valued highly among the Romans.

defs.en: To hold dear; to cherish.
defs.ex: I value these old photographs.

ja: 値を設ける。～個の値に分ける。
高く評価する。重んじる。貴ぶ。

defs.en: More than one (of an indeterminate set of things).
defs.ex: Various books have been taken.

defs.en: Having a broad range (of different elements).
defs.ex: The reasons are various.

defs.en: That varies or differs from others; variant; different, sundry.
defs.ex: a various reading of a Biblical text

ja: 変化に富む。いろいろな。多様な。

defs.en: A formalized choice on legally relevant measures such as employment or appointment to office or a proceeding about a legal dispute.
defs.ex: The city council decided the matter should go to public vote.

defs.en: An act or instance of participating in such a choice, e.g., by submitting a ballot.
defs.ex: The Supreme Court upheld the principle of one person, one vote.

defs.en: Any judgment of intellect leading not only to a formal opinion but also to a particular choice in a legally relevant measure, a point of view as published.
defs.ex: dissenting vote (i.e. in particular the differing opinion published with a judicial judgment considered as a source of information)

defs.en: a spending area or group of appropriations within the national budget, representing specific sectors, departments or functional areas.
To cast a vote; to assert a formalized choice in an election.
defs.ex: Q: Did you vote last month? A: Yes. I voted for John Smith, and it's a shame that he lost; you can't blame me for the mess we're in now.

defs.en: To choose or grant (some objective) by means of a vote, or by general consent.
defs.ex: The directors voted an increase in R&D spending.

defs.en: To exercise one's voting right upon (a ballot or a share of stock).
defs.ex: vote your ballot

defs.en: A specific form or variation of something.
A translation from one language to another.
defs.ex: It's only in the King James Version of the Bible.

defs.en: An account or description from a particular point of view, especially as contrasted with another account.
defs.ex: He gave another version of the affair.

defs.en: A particular revision (of software, firmware, CPU, etc.).
defs.ex: Upgrade to the latest version for new features and bug fixes.

defs.en: A condition of the uterus in which its axis is deflected from its normal position without being bent upon itself. See anteversion and retroversion.
To keep track of (a file, document, etc.) in a versioning system.
Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.
defs.ex: The human voice is the oldest musical instrument in history.

defs.en: Sound made through vibration of the vocal cords; sonant, or intonated, utterance; tone; — distinguished from mere breath sound as heard in whispering and voiceless consonants.
The tone or sound emitted by an object.
The faculty or power of utterance.
defs.ex: to cultivate the voice

defs.en: That which is communicated; message; meaning.
To give utterance or expression to; to utter; to publish; to announce
defs.ex: He voiced the sentiments of the nation.

defs.en: To utter audibly, with tone and not just breath.
To fit for producing the proper sounds; to regulate the tone of
defs.ex: voice the pipes of an organ

defs.en: To assign the voice flag to a user on IRC, permitting them to send messages to the channel.
To act as a voice actor to portray a character.

ja: ～と声に出す、言葉にする、発言する。
吹き替える。～の声を演じる。
（パイプオルガンを）調律する。

defs.en: A shape resembling the letter.
defs.ex: The impact was so strong, it bent the bar into a v.

defs.en: To habitually go to (someone in distress, sickness etc.) to comfort them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
To go and meet (a person) as an act of friendliness or sociability.
defs.ex: She decided to visit her grandparents for Christmas.

defs.en: Of God: to appear to (someone) to comfort, bless, or chastise or punish them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
Of a sickness, misfortune etc.: to afflict (someone).
To inflict punishment, vengeance for (an offense) on or upon someone.
A single act of visiting.
defs.ex: Next time you're in Manchester, give me a visit.

defs.en: A meeting with a doctor at their surgery or the doctor's at one's home.
A main road or highway, especially in ancient Rome. (Mainly used in set phrases, below.)
A small hole in a printed circuit board filled with metal which connects two or more layers.
An electrical connection which connects two or more layers on a printed circuit board or an integrated circuit.
By way of; passing through.
defs.ex: They drove from New York to Los Angeles via Omaha.

defs.en: By (means of); using.
defs.ex: I'll send you the information via e-mail.
